nodes.Name: Server
nodes.DocComment:
A Server is an HTTP server listening on a system-chosen port on the
local loopback interface, for use in end-to-end HTTP tests.

Fields.Name: URL
Fields.DocComment: base URL of form http://ipaddr:port with no trailing slash

nodes.Name: serveFlag
nodes.DocComment:
When debugging a particular http server-based test,
this flag lets you run

	go test -run='^BrokenTest$' -httptest.serve=127.0.0.1:8000

to start the broken server so you can interact with it manually.
We only register this flag if it looks like the caller knows about it
and is trying to use it as we don't want to pollute flags and this
isn't really part of our API. Don't depend on this.

nodes.Name: NewServer
nodes.DocComment:
NewServer starts and returns a new [Server].
The caller should call Close when finished, to shut it down.

nodes.Name: NewUnstartedServer
nodes.DocComment:
NewUnstartedServer returns a new [Server] but doesn't start it.

After changing its configuration, the caller should call Start or
StartTLS.

The caller should call Close when finished, to shut it down.

nodes.Name: Start
nodes.DocComment: Start starts a server from NewUnstartedServer.

nodes.Name: StartTLS
nodes.DocComment: StartTLS starts TLS on a server from NewUnstartedServer.

nodes.Name: NewTLSServer
nodes.DocComment:
NewTLSServer starts and returns a new [Server] using TLS.
The caller should call Close when finished, to shut it down.

nodes.Name: Close
nodes.DocComment:
Close shuts down the server and blocks until all outstanding
requests on this server have completed.

nodes.Name: CloseClientConnections
nodes.DocComment: CloseClientConnections closes any open HTTP connections to the test Server.

nodes.Name: Certificate
nodes.DocComment:
Certificate returns the certificate used by the server, or nil if
the server doesn't use TLS.

nodes.Name: Client
nodes.DocComment:
Client returns an HTTP client configured for making requests to the server.
It is configured to trust the server's TLS test certificate and will
close its idle connections on [Server.Close].
Use Server.URL as the base URL to send requests to the server.
The returned client will also redirect any requests to "example.com"
or its subdomains to the server.

nodes.Name: wrap
nodes.DocComment:
wrap installs the connection state-tracking hook to know which
connections are idle.

nodes.Name: closeConn
nodes.DocComment:
closeConn closes c.
s.mu must be held.

nodes.Name: closeConnChan
nodes.DocComment:
closeConnChan is like closeConn, but takes an optional channel to receive a value
when the goroutine closing c is done.
